title: Respec: agent-first VSDD toolkit on the crosslink chassis (fresh design cycle)
description:
Goal: 

Acceptance criteria:
- 

Fresh design cycle superseding the 2026-05 design corpus (4 DESIGN-*.md docs + binary-first plan #11-#17), initiated by operator 2026-07-18 after a five-dataset evaluation (bookmark-cli-manual, issue-tracker-cli, #12/#13 cycles, vsdd-suite self-reviews, vsdd-cli/wip review-logs), a read of the VSDD/VDD whitepapers, crosslink governing docs, and the Thermite harness (ACToR).

Mandate: vsdd-cli becomes the methodology layer installed into crosslink's seams (rules, skills, hooks, gates, swarm); mdatron stays the artifact-conformance engine invoked at action time; delivery is agent-first (context + constraints + hooks; binaries are organs, not the product).

Operator decisions recorded: agent-side interpretation; determinism in the process, not the tool; crosslink is the required chassis (two-mode parity retired); provably = in-flight gating AND after-the-fact audit; phase state = written artifact; Red Gate = keep and mechanize (red suite provably fails against pre-implementation commit; mutation floors; critic post-hoc tests); no coinages / plain names.

Core behavioral contracts to author in Phase 1a: deterministic phase answer ('what phase are we in'); directive reconciliation (every mid-flow operator directive classified — Phase 4 routing / spec amendment / recorded override + re-entry path — before execution; silent execution is a named defect); phase-exit by verifiable gate, not assertion; finding lifecycle state lives in crosslink alone (findings filed in subject repo's tracker); composition = activation axes keyed on artifact surfaces with pairs preserved and mechanically separated (validator lifecycle, no self-validation).

Deliverables: lean methodology.md (process spec) + toolkit DESIGN.md (implementation contract), authored in .design/ per chassis convention.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Phase composition declaration — phase: phase-1a; composed domains: solution-owner (primary), solution-architect, quality-engineer, ai-engineer; composition mode: skill-interactive (operator + agent co-authoring); operator confirmation: confirmed in session 2026-07-18; artifact under design: methodology.md (process spec) + toolkit DESIGN.md (implementation contract), drafted in .design/agent-first-vsdd-toolkit.md. Activation rationale: no ui-surface, no user-data, no locales; ai-runtime axis active (methodology executed by agents); TW+DR activate at the doc-review gate, not during authoring.

Late additions from operator root-cause interview: vocabulary/schema maturity lifecycle (draft vs established; reification requires registration), closed-world artifact set (route table as allowlist; computed names for generated artifacts), enforcement-as-pattern-data (not bespoke hook scripts), evidence-gated finding filing (citation verified against HEAD / failing test), build-dispatch scope manifests, declared coverage (absence of looking is a recorded fact), fresh-container install gate. All items referenced by plain names — no code labels, per the register discipline this spec itself mandates. Next: operator read → cold-reader (TW+DR) gate on the spec → Phase 1b verification architecture → Phase 1c decomposition with estate cleanup as layer 0.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Spec-stage cold review dispatch (Phase 1a gate on the draft itself). Input: .design/agent-first-vsdd-toolkit.md at sha256:e0ef9b11f53ab35bdd8cd601fe80b9c19ab49cb87d70727591bf025a922ef068 (186 lines), uncommitted working copy. Composition: four cold reviewer lenses, separate agents (pair separation: session agent is the author/TW side, so the cold-reader pair half runs cold): solution-architect (structural consistency, contradictions, cross-reference integrity), quality-engineer (falsifiability, contract-to-criteria traceability), documentation-reviewer (cold-reader executability, implicit knowledge, forward references), register-and-vocabulary (the doc against its own conformance rules). Finding discipline: evidence-gated (line citation, verified against the file), declared coverage (clean areas stated, no empty issues), no scope-stretch. Findings triage to follow with operator.
